source.check: names, labels and votes read on the page image (Newry Telegraph, 4 June 1949, p. 7); winners confirmed by the majorities in the Newry Reporter, 9 June 1949, p. 3 (21 Glassdrummond, 23 Dunaman) and by the annual-meeting attendance (Newry Reporter, 16 June 1949, p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the 17 electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Three divisions were contested (Ballymartin, Dunaman, Glassdrummond); Greencastle was left unopposed when T. A. Knowles withdrew. Speers printed 'Spiers' in the results and 'Speers' in the nominations and the attendance list; a Unionist gain from the Anti-Partitionists.
